motion.name: events-action
motion.purpose: Events primary-action hover; disabled under reduced-motion preference.

extensions.heroTreatment: Events-specific desktop scale approximately 25% larger at normal zoom: max width 1400px, gap 45px, padding 40px, heading clamp 88–110px, tagline 40px, body 20px/max425px, foundation label 14px, CTA17px/min54px. Earlier mobile scale preserved. Custom SVG photo shapes with white contours; communication photo scale1.2. Actual Chrome125% zoom not tested.

components.name: Events Primary Action
components.description: Deep-blue action; desktop hero uses 17px copy and 54px minimum height, with earlier mobile sizing preserved.

components.name: Events Secondary Action
components.description: Outlined supporting action; desktop hero uses 17px copy and 54px minimum height, with earlier mobile sizing preserved.

components.name: Events Search
components.description: Labeled search field within native details when more than one event exists.
components.html: <label for="ds-events-search">Search events by name or location</label><input class="ds-events-input" id="ds-events-search" type="search" placeholder="Search events or places">

components.name: Events Category
components.description: Selected category chip; selection is exposed through aria-pressed.

components.name: Events Listing Row
components.description: Bordered white image/date/details row; stacked on mobile.
components.css: .ds-events-card{background:#fff;color:#0b5f8a;border-radius:16px;padding:24px;border:1px solid #cfdfe8;font-family:"Comic Neue",sans-serif}.ds-events-card h3{font-family:"Marissa Font","Comic Neue",sans-serif;font-weight:400}.ds-events-card a{color:#0b5f8a;text-underline-offset:5px}.ds-events-card a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-events-card a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #0b5f8a;outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: This is an extracted reference, restricted to the public brand evidence in global CSS, the donate page, and the finalized `/events` implementation. It does not prescribe a new global visual world or describe administrative interfaces. The existing public site is authoritative.
keyCharacteristics: Ocean-blue identity and pale-blue supporting surfaces.
Marissa headings and Comic Neue copy, respecting accessibility font overrides.
Rounded actions and restrained existing watercolor artwork.
dos: Do follow the existing public-site palette, type, and assets.
Do keep events-specific color and contrast rules in its CSS module.
Do respect accessibility font modes and explicit focus and selection states.
donts: Don't treat the events layout as a new global identity.
Don't reintroduce the rejected warm-paper editorial direction for events.
Don't use arbitrary hexadecimal Tailwind color classes on interactive elements or their ancestors; repository contrast selectors can override them.
